profile.headline: Director, Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Dedicated and highly motivated software engineer with years of hands-on experience in software architecture and programming. Established project and team management experience combined with a consistent record of developing products from its early stages to conclusion. Ability to research and introduce new technologies and proven capability to work in different areas.

Technical Skills: 
AI: AWS Bedrock, Microsoft copilot, Spring-AI
AWS: EC2, ALB, AWS Services (CloudFront, Lambda, SNS, IAM, Codebuild, CodeDeploy)
Java: Maven, Javascript, Spring Framework, Spring boot, Apache Camel, Solr, thymeleaf
Web Development: Ember.js, Angular, React, jQuery
DevOps: Jenkins, Nexus, Docker, GitHub, DockerHub, Bitbucket, AWS Codebuild, AWS CodeDeploy
Microsoft: Azure, MS Dynamics 365 for Finances and Operations, X++, LCS, .NET, C#
Python: Odoo, CherryPy, Web2py
Other: REST API design, SOA, WSDL, WebServices, OData, OAuth, SQL
Agile methodology, SCRUM, Enterprise Design Patterns, Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Sr. Software Dev/Architect
positions.description:
Designed and developed the Revegy Enterprise application, a key account management and sales enablement platform.
● Designed and implemented a new software stack for the platform, transforming it from amonolithic app to a service message driven architecture. This was based on kafka and springboot services.
● Worked on the platform’s frontend using EmberJs and Angular frameworks.
● Introduced artificial intelligence to the platform using AWS bedrock. To accomplish this, I
created multiple agents and knowledge bases to provide Retrieval Augmented Generation
(RAG) allowing the inclusion of contextual information of the platform private data. Also, I
created a copilot agent to provide a chatbot so the users could interact with Revegy on how to
use the platform and its best practices.

positions.title: Sr Software Architect
positions.description:
•	Assisted the CIO and the Director of Development in defining the company technology path, software architecture and the introduction of new technology.
•	Participated in the implementation and customization of Dynamics 365 Finances and Operations in the company.
•	Architecture, design and full-stack hands-on development of multiple applications for the Recycling industry.
•	Experience with Continuous Integration and Automation using Jenkins, Docker and other CI/CD tools.

positions.title: Specialist Master
positions.description: •	Participated in the architecture and design of an IoT software infrastructure that integrates sensor technologies and data feeds with business logic to enable the development, deployment, simulation and management of highly distributed collective intelligent networks.

positions.title: Sr Architect
positions.description:
•	Participated in the architecture definition of the next generation of the company clienteling solution,  a web client application interacting with Microsoft CRM through a set of REST and Web Services.
•	Oriented other developers in the introduction of new technologies.

positions.title: .NET Sr. Architect
positions.description:
•	Participated in the architecture, design and development of multiple services and applications with the purpose of managing and monitoring a group of SimpleC companion devices connected. 
•	Assisted and coordinated with external departments in the preparation of testing cases, devices configuration and servers installation.

positions.title: Embedded Framework Manager
positions.description: •	Designed and developed different modules of Picsel’s new UI Platform, including a new Framework and SDK which facilitates the creation of rich Mobile applications running in multiple platforms.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Involved in the Architecture and development of different products in the RFID department.  
•	Participated in the introduction of the RFID technology in the company and engaged in the definition of several products from the early stages to final releases. 
•	Supervised a group of software engineers and developers in the execution of different projects.  
•	Assisted the sales department in the introduction of RFID Anywhere™ in several accounts.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked directly with the CTO on the design, architecture, and development of several products targeting the enterprise mobility market. 
•	Oversaw and managed a team of software engineers in the proper completion of the design, programming and testing stages of such products.
